title: How I'd Roll Out AI in Any Business (Exact 4-Stage Framework)
description:
Most AI rollouts don’t fail because the tools aren’t capable. They fail because businesses buy AI before they have a clear path for adoption, security, governance, and measurable ROI.

In this video, I break down the **4-stage AI rollout framework** I use with businesses and IT providers to move from basic AI productivity to secure, enterprise-scale automation without starting with one massive project.

🚀 **What You'll Learn:**
Why most AI rollouts struggle to produce ROI
The four biggest mistakes businesses make with AI
The **Land → Ground → Build → Connect** framework


💡 **Why Watch?**
Too many companies start their AI strategy with the biggest project they can imagine.

The better approach is progression.

Start by helping employees become more productive. Then connect AI to trusted data. Next, automate repeatable departmental work. Only after those foundations exist should you move into large, cross-business transformation projects.

Each stage should create measurable value while preparing the organization for what comes next.

👍 **Engage with Me:**
If you found this video helpful, hit Like, subscribe, and share it with someone responsible for AI strategy or Microsoft 365.

I'd also love to hear from you: **What stage is your AI rollout in today?**

Check out my free Skool community for the full **Secure AI Enablement Framework**, graphics, templates, and implementation resources:

https://www.skool.com/tminus365/about

Check Your Microsoft 365 Security in 60 Seconds

As AI connects to more of your business data, your Microsoft 365 security posture becomes the foundation everything else depends on. I built CloudCapsule to automate that assessment across every tenant you manage. Run your tenant and one client free at cloudcapsule.io.
